chapter: Harry Parker's, the district and its characters
title: Playing guitar in Charlie Galloway's Dixieland band
summary: Dawson played two or three years with bassist Charlie Galloway, who walked on a crutch, in a band with clarinetist Cripple Pill (Henry Ross).

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

I played guitar with Charlie Galloway for a while, not too long. I believe I played with his band about two, three years. That's about all. Charlie Galloway was a bass player and he was the leader of the band. He had one leg, walked with a crutch. And he had a good Dixieland band, jazz band. And I played, I remember playing with him a while, you know. Was he an older man than you or younger? Oh yeah, he was, uh, he was younger than me. Yeah. Who was in his band? Well, uh, they had, uh, some of the old fellas out at, uh, I'm trying to think now. Had a little kind of cripple fella called Pill a clarinet player. You heard of him?

Cripple Pill. Oh yeah. He would have told us about Cripple Pill, uh, uh, Henry Ross. Henry Ross. I didn't know his right name, but all we know was Pill. Crowback? Yeah.
